input: I want to advertise to businesses more for automated custom dev shop / describe your problem and it gets built.
task: Advertise the free custom dev shop to businesses (owner direct request)

errors.what: First full platform/pages test run failed across build tests: new post description was 165 chars (limit 160). Shortened; rerun.
First render of the CTA buttons had invisible text: pf-site.css loads after the page's inline style and sets .pf-hero a / .prose a colour. Fixed with higher specificity.

doc_friction.issue: The front-matter check exits 0 on a description over 160 characters, but the site build throws on it and fails ~20 build tests. Running the checker does not catch what the build will reject.

deviations.why: Direct owner request; routed with --track ventures (closest by nature) rather than the weighted draw.

notes: Verified: node --test custom-development-page, site-nav, feedback-page tests 22/22 pass; check_post_frontmatter clean for the new post; Chromium renders of custom-development/ and the hub at 1200px and 390px, light and dark, no horizontal scroll, CTAs legible. Full platform/pages/*.test.mjs rerun: 90 ok and 0 not ok at the time of writing; CI on the PR is the final check. Outreach copy is for the owner to post; nothing posts automatically. ref tags used are in platform/counter/core.mjs REFS.
